title: Grusch on JRE: CIA psi programs as a key to stored craft

tellings.quote: Remember what Grush said on uh JRE uh you know they they started talking about remote viewing stuff and and David Grush says well what if the CIA started looking into this as a sigh stuff as a possible solution to serve as a key to unlock some stuff we have sitting around in a warehouse.

plain: David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned UFO whistleblower, is said to have suggested in 2024 that the CIA might have looked into psychic abilities as a way to unlock craft it has stored in a warehouse. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb recalls this from Grusch's appearance on the Joe Rogan Experience, a popular podcast hosted by Joe Rogan. According to UAPGerb, the talk turned to remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind, and Grusch wondered whether such mind-based methods were being studied as a "key" to recovered objects.
